1.name: We are the same.
1.ov: New recruit Erling Haaland joins Manchester City and sets the tone for the 2022-23 season with his striking goalscoring feats.

1.name: We have to take responsibility.
1.ov: A victory in the season's first Manchester derby pits the Blues against rivals Arsenal in an exciting Premier League title race.

1.name: I want my warriors!
1.ov: Club manager Pep Guardiola drives up the pressure after City suffers a loss against Southampton, knocking them out of the EFL Cup.

1.name: We can beat them all.
1.ov: The Blues move within sight of the treble win as they advance to the quarterfinals of the UEFA Champions League and the FA Cup.

1.name: Do you want to play in the final?
1.ov: After clinching the title from Arsenal and winning the first-ever Manchester derby final, City secures the Premier League and FA Cup double.

1.name: We're going to win.
1.ov: The Blues arrive in Istanbul to face Inter Milan in a hard-fought UEFA Champions League final and lock in the continental treble.
